verdict.rationale: CrewAI lets users build autonomous agents and crews and event-driven Flows for AI automations. CrewAI AMP deploys crews to managed infrastructure, where they run asynchronously: runs start via POST /kickoff, are polled via GET /status, report through webhook streaming, and are monitored in real time. A community user describes an email-triage crew that labels, drafts, alerts and deletes mail on its own. missing for 10: documented scheduling or event triggers (cron, inbound-event) for unattended background runs, background execution outside the paid AMP managed platform, and independent hands-on corroboration of long-running background operation.
